text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, a URA official visited the academy for a meeting regarding an event.

text_block_list.name: URA Official
text_block_list.text: —So, in order to get the races even more exciting, we want to promote them broadly to the public.

text_block_list.name: URA Official
text_block_list.text: After all, nothing beats watching a race live in person! And for that, we need people to actually come visit the track!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Is there something troubling you? If you'd like, I can lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later. In order to promote the racetrack, we arrived on-site with Kitasan Black and the others.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, an empty racetrack with no spectators is so quiet, it gives off a totally different impression!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Being able to enter a racetrack on its day off feels pretty VIP, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're such a kid! Remember, we're here for work today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... from here on, the three of us are shooting a promotional video for the racetrack, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yup! To get people to visit the racetrack, showing off its charms firsthand is definitely the way to go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Alright, you two, let's do this! Let's bring full energy to this shoot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Special Week-san! Straight to the point: what's the best part about seeing a race in person?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Um... the sheer power! Having horse girls sprint right in front of your eyes has incredible power!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Plus, the food stalls are amazing! Have you tried the takoyaki yet? I absolutely love it! In fact, I sometimes eat way too much before a race—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Cut, cuuuuut! Geez, Spe-chan! You've gotta do it with way more dignity!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're supposed to be playing a star horse girl, remember? You need to make them think, 'I can see the horse girl of my dreams in person! I want to go meet her!'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, that was the concept, wasn't it! Ahaha... showing dignity is tough, desu_ne...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How's this, how's this? Me, striding briskly through the paddock! Does it look cool, like the President? —*Ehem!*

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's great, Teio-san! You look so super cute!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ! Not cute! I told you to shoot it so I look *cool*!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm the invincible Teio-sama, you know? I want to project that true presence of an emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Tada!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, what do we do... The harder Teio-san tries to look cool...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...the cuter she ends up looking, desu_ne...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAHHH!!
...*glance*.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan! You totally just glanced at the camera! What are you doing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I got worried about whether I was running with 'dignity and presence'!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine if you just run normally! I'm sure you can do it, Kita-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll go for one more run! HAAAAAHHHHHHH!! ...*glance*.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, I sound so robotic, desu. Like I'm just reading off cue cards...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mine is totally not what I imagined either! The President walks with way more cool poise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me too... I really don't want Dad or Dia-chan to see this.
choice_data_list: Should we redo the whole thing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's best. Starting from my interview once more—

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no need for a retake at all.
Take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! The yakisoba is super duper delicious, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, no fair, Spe-chan! Keep all the good stuff to yourself! Let me have a bite too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Now, now, you two. Still, the racetrack really is so spacious and feels amazing~!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Watching everyone interact so warmly made me want to film it on impulse.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? You had the camera rolling for something like that?

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, isn't it truly wonderful? Showing a side of the three of you that's different from when you dash across the turf.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Being able to see expressions like these that you can't get just from race footage is truly the real charm of the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Before a match, or right after finishing a run—seeing everyone rejoice or praise one another is a real part of who we are, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... even if it's in an unexpected way, I'm glad we could be of help, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having captured an appealing promo video, visitor traffic to the racetrack increased more than ever before.
